verdict.rationale: Manufact publishes public checklist scores in an MCP catalog, so developers can compare servers by score. Those scores come from its automated protocol-compliance and platform-readiness audit, which also runs as an open scan against any MCP URL. The public catalog is only mentioned in a changelog entry, and the other signal types in the story are not evidenced. Missing for 10: usage counts, health/liveness signals for catalog servers, verification badges, in-depth docs on the catalog's comparison features, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges

citations.quote: Run a basic publishing readiness scan against any MCP URL without signing in, and browse public checklist scores at manufact.com/mcp-catalog.
The Checklist tab runs an automated audit of your server for protocol compliance and platform readiness
